headlines.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Jurassic Express vs. Swerve in our Glory vs. Hobbs & Starks went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.89 ? a solid showing. Swerve in our Glory and Hobbs & Starks was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 40th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a significant milestone for the title. It marked Jurassic Express's 10th match with the title on the line. A chaotic three-way tag team war ? Christian Cage's interference neutralized Team Taz's cheating attempts, letting Jurassic Express survive a flurry of near-falls to retain their titles.

Rewind to 2024, when Will Ospreay vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Hechicero vs. Jay White vs. Lio Rush vs. Mistico vs. Orange Cassidy vs. PAC vs. Shota Umino settled things in a Casino Battle Royale match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.75 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. In a nine-man Casino Gauntlet loaded with NJPW and CMLL stars, Ospreay outlasted the field with an Oscutter on Orange Cassidy to earn an AEW World Title shot against Strickland at Forbidden Door.

Rewind to 2022, when it was title-change night for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as CM Punk vs. Adam Page battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.93 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. For CM Punk, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. An emotional main event ? Punk's first world title win in over nine years, in a match that saw Page hesitate on a heel turn and pay for it, ending Page's reign in dramatic, tearful fashion.
